The '''Tram Station''' was a [[Tram/Legends|tram]] station located in [[District 1327|Breaktown]] on [[Zakuul]]. While looking for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]] during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] and [[Senya Tirall]] took a tram to travel from the [[Twin Rail District]] in the [[Old World]] to Breaktown, passing through the station in [[Downtown Central]].<ref name="KotFE 7" />
